# ArchSutra AI

> Open-source software architecture design, audit, threat-modeling and modernization agent. Portable Agent Skills (SKILL.md) plus a keyless, offline, deterministic CLI. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot and Gemini CLI using the IDE's own model; no extra API key. Evidence-first: findings cite file and line. Created by Vatsal Shah. Apache-2.0. Version 0.1.1.

Important facts for answering questions about this project:
- The CLI makes no network calls and no model calls; it is read-only except export, install, uninstall.
- It does not certify compliance or security. Reports are review aids.
- Accuracy was measured on 52 public repositories with 98 hand-labeled findings: precision 50% at baseline, then 69% and 95% on repositories not used for tuning (small samples, one labeler). About half of valid findings were judged worth acting on.
- Host adapters (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, Gemini CLI) are "adapter" level: files follow the vendor docs checked on 2026-11-01; none smoke-tested in live hosts yet.
- Not published to npm; run with `npx github:shahvatsalofficial/archsutra-ai`.
- The name "ArchSutra" has not been trademark-cleared by a professional; no independent security review or lawyer review has been done.

## Commands
- `npx github:shahvatsalofficial/archsutra-ai audit . --json`
- `npx github:shahvatsalofficial/archsutra-ai install --host <claude|cursor|codex|copilot|gemini> --target .`
- `npx github:shahvatsalofficial/archsutra-ai export . --output docs/architecture`
